title: Add AGENTS.md for Cursor Cloud environment setup
body: Adds `AGENTS.md` with Cursor Cloud specific development instructions for this React + TypeScript + Vite project. ### What's included - Key npm scripts reference - Dev server startup notes (including `--host 0.0.0.0` for cloud VMs) - Node.js/nvm setup context ### Environment verification All checks pass: - `npm run lint` — clean - `npm run build` — TypeScript type-check + Vite production build succeeds - `npm run dev` — Vite dev server starts and serves the app with HMR ### Demo App loads and counter interaction works as expected: ![App initial state](https://cursor.com/artifacts/c/art-256d0b64-ba37-47e6-b755-a0abb6afd908) ![Counter incremented to 3](https://cursor.com/artifacts/c/art-33da72e9-e3da-4f1a-9c4f-9c687de7ba48)
